$comment: Rules of ctx-lint, shared by tools/ctx-lint (Python, the reference) and the VS Code extension. Warnings only: ContextDoc is non-binding. Change here, regenerate fixtures/expected.json with ctx-lint, run both suites. Patterns cover English and Italian.

messages.L001: ${lines} lines, over ~${max}: a .ctx this long is probably repeating the code — keep only what would surprise a reader
messages.L002: looks copied from the code (${signature}): signatures are readable in the source, describe intent instead
messages.L003legacy: it comes from ConceptDoc — drop it, or turn what matters into tensions
messages.L003unknown: readers and tools will ignore it
messages.L004: also in ${other}: cross-cutting context belongs in project.ctx only
messages.L005: ${count} of ${total} steps expect an error for a missing or invalid input: validating every argument of internal objects makes code defensive and verbose — keep such checks at the public boundary
messages.L006vague: expect '${expect}' is not observable: say what the reader can check (a value, a state, an error)
messages.L008: purpose is ${chars} characters: one line saying what the file does, not how
